query: best way to lose weight for a child
plausible_answers: Whole-family lifestyle change with the choosemyplate.gov plate method (half fruits/veggies, quarter lean protein, quarter whole grains) plus aerobic exercise
Pediatrician-led monitoring with attainable goals (1-4 lb/month), a food diary, and biweekly weight checks
A formal multi-disciplinary weight loss program for children whose home efforts fail
